Persistence.definition: last observed grid value at forecast origin

Rolling-3 Mean.definition: mean of latest up-to-3 observed grid values

Bounded OLS Trend.definition: per-grid OLS trend using all history available at origin; target-year extrapolation clipped to training-history global min/max

Bounded Theil-Sen Trend.definition: per-grid median pairwise-slope robust trend using all history available at origin; target-year extrapolation clipped to training-history global min/max

binary_rule: If development values are genuinely binary {0,1}, candidate forecasts are clipped then thresholded at 0.5.

metric_policy.MAPE: not used because predictor values may be zero or negative

engineered_feature_policy: Do not forecast engineered lag/delta/history/interaction/neighbour features independently. Reconstruct them later from forecast base predictors using the original feature-engineering logic.
selection_policy: No final predictor forecasting method selected in Step 26B. All frozen candidate definitions proceed to Step 27.
